snippet.description:
Journalist Pablo Torre says that President Trump’s embrace of the UFC is a sign of retreat, calling it a “safe space” where he can count on cheers. Speaking with Astead Herndon, Torre explains what Trump’s presence at sporting events reveals about his popularity.
